channel.description: Latest articles from Paul Denton Online (pauldenton.co.uk)

item.title: New car has great MPG
item.description: Bought a new car at the end of May 2011 as the cost of petrol was rocketing up. Bought a diesel which is currently averaging 62.0mpg Can get to work and back 8 times on a tank compared to 5 in the old car so I'm well happy about that.

item.title: Holiday to America
item.description: Been searching for my next holiday to the states and shocked at the way the prices have gone up. Many of the places I want to go to are nearly double the price that they were last time. Florida is booked for March so hopefully I might get on the Harry Potter ride this time round.

item.title: Diet time again for me
item.description: Time I went on a diet. It's been slowly creeping up again and Xmas is the tipping point. Need to lose weight before my holiday in March.
